evidence.title: Intro Font Combinations & Free Alternatives · Typewolf

name: Typewolf
summary: Typography resource with font lists, pairings, free alternatives and a daily showcase of fonts used on real websites.
description: An independent typography site by Jeremiah Shoaf, running since 2013. It features one website a day with the fonts it uses, typeface pages with specimens, similar-font and free-alternative suggestions, curated top-10 font lists by classification and alternatives, plus font pairing lookbooks and guides and resources for choosing type.
contains: daily site-of-the-day writeup of fonts used on real websites
top-10 font lists by classification (sans-serif, serif, slab serif, monospaced …)
alternative lists for Helvetica, Futura, Proxima Nova and others
free font lists, lookbooks and guides, some paid
